patch:
--- e5138d6:r1a7_threading_project/docs/source_records/2026-11-09_grasp_insertion/research_code_snapshot/current/transfer_control/experimental/r1a7_cartesian_stream_control_kd30_posvel_wu_dqik_u010_auto_grasp_direct_v1.py
+++ /home/robot/unitree_sim_isaaclab_threading/r1a7_threading_project/transfer_control/experimental/r1a7_cartesian_stream_control_kd30_posvel_wu_dqik_u010_auto_grasp_direct_v1.py
@@ -1025,8 +1025,15 @@
                 self.preopen_jitter_max
             )
 
+            # PREOPEN_WRIST_EU_ONLY_V1
+            #
+            # Right Wrist controls the lateral/Y alignment.
+            # Its vertical image error (ev) must not block
+            # automatic OPEN.
             wrist_inside = (
-                wm["en"]
+                abs(
+                    wm["eu"]
+                )
                 <=
                 self.preopen_norm_max
                 and
@@ -1044,7 +1051,9 @@
 
                 and
 
-                wm["en"]
+                abs(
+                    wm["eu"]
+                )
                 <=
                 0.60
                 *
@@ -1171,10 +1180,93 @@
                 )
             )
 
+            # ================================================
+            # GRASP_FORWARD_NUDGE_CLOSE_GATE_V1
+            #
+            # External alignment is now followed by a deliberate
+            # small X forward nudge in Fusion.
+            #
+            # Do NOT close merely at the original image overlap.
+            # Close only after:
+            #   1. Fusion confirms forward nudge completed,
+            #   2. Wrist jaw-corridor latch is still true.
+            #
+            # Fusion state must also be fresh.
+            # ================================================
+
+            try:
+                nudge_state = json.loads(
+                    Path(
+                        "/tmp/r1a7_wire_grasp_fusion_shadow_v1.json"
+                    ).read_text()
+                )
+
+                nudge_ts = float(
+                    nudge_state.get(
+                        "timestamp",
+                        0.0,
+                    )
+                    or 0.0
+                )
+
+                nudge_age_s = (
+                    time.time()
+                    -
+                    nudge_ts
+                )
+
+                nudge_done = bool(
+                    0.0
+                    <=
+                    nudge_age_s
+                    <=
+                    0.25
+                    and
+                    nudge_state.get(
+                        "grasp_forward_nudge_done",
+                        False,
+                    )
+                )
+
+            except Exception:
+
+                nudge_done = False
+
+
+            # ================================================
+            # GRASP_SEQUENTIAL_CLOSE_GATE_V1
+            #
+            # Do not close from the old one-way jaw latch.
+            # CLOSE is allowed only when Fusion reports that the
+            # complete ordered visual sequence has finished AND
+            # the current Wrist geometry still passes final check.
+            # ================================================
+
+            try:
+                fusion_close_ready = bool(
+                    0.0
+                    <=
+                    nudge_age_s
+                    <=
+                    0.25
+                    and
+                    nudge_state.get(
+                        "grasp_close_ready",
+                        False,
+                    )
+                    and
+                    nudge_state.get(
+                        "grasp_sequence_stage",
+                        ""
+                    )
+                    ==
+                    "READY_TO_CLOSE"
+                )
+            except Exception:
+                fusion_close_ready = False
+
             close_ready = (
-                ext_close
-                and
-                wrist_close
+                fusion_close_ready
             )
